description: Na₇VN₄ crystallizes in the cubic Pa̅3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VN₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.54 Å) and three longer (2.57 Å) Na-N bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent VN₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaN₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one VN₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.56 Å. V is bonded to four N atoms to form VN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten NaN₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.86 Å) and three longer (1.90 Å) V-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one V atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one V atom.
